mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserByIdxx */ U.USER_NUMB , U.PROF_NUMB , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , U.BGIM_NUMB , BF.FILE_PATH AS BGIM_PATH , U.USER_IDXX , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_PROV , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_STAT , U.ONBD_YSNO , U.WTHD_DATE , U.DELT_DATE , U.INTR_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM BF ON U.BGIM_NUMB = BF.FILE_NUMB WHERE U.USER_IDXX = #{userIdxx}

SELECT /* getUserByNumb */ U.USER_NUMB , U.PROF_NUMB , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , U.BGIM_NUMB , BF.FILE_PATH AS BGIM_PATH , U.USER_IDXX , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_PROV , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeUserStat}, U.USER_STAT, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS USER_STAT_NAME , U.ONBD_YSNO , U.WTHD_DATE , U.DELT_DATE , U.INTR_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM BF ON U.BGIM_NUMB = BF.FILE_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getUserFileForUpdate */ U.USER_NUMB , U.PROF_NUMB , U.BGIM_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE
SELECT /* getUserOnboardingYsno */ U.ONBD_YSNO FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserSettingDtl */ U.USER_NUMB , S.ENGL_YSNO AS ENGLISH_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RSTA_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS READING_STATISTICS_YSNO , COALESCE(S.GOAL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS READING_GOAL_YSNO , COALESCE(S.IMFD_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS IMAGE_FEED_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RPUB_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS REPORT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_YSNO , COALESCE(S.LKAL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS LIKE_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RPAL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPLY_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.FOLL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS FOLLOW_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.CLUB_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS CLUB_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.CHAT_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS CHAT_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RDUE_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPORT_DUE_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.LKDF_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPORT_LIKE_DEFAULT_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RPDF_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPORT_REPLY_DEFAULT_YSNO FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_USSETX S ON S.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
mapper.insert: /* uptUserAlimSetting */ INSERT INTO TM_USSETX ( USER_NUMB , RSTA_YSNO , GOAL_YSNO , IMFD_YSNO , RPUB_YSNO , LKAL_YSNO , RPAL_YSNO , FOLL_YSNO , CLUB_YSNO , CHAT_YSNO , RDUE_YSNO , LKDF_YSNO , RPDF_YSNO , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userNumb} , 'N' , 'Y' , 'Y' , 'N' , #{likeAlimYsno} , #{replyAlimYsno} , #{followAlimYsno} , #{clubAlimYsno} , #{chatAlimYsno} , #{reportDueAlimYsno} , #{reportLikeDefaultYsno} , #{reportReplyDefaultYsno} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LKAL_YSNO = VALUES(LKAL_YSNO) , RPAL_YSNO = VALUES(RPAL_YSNO) , FOLL_YSNO = VALUES(FOLL_YSNO) , CLUB_YSNO = VALUES(CLUB_YSNO) , CHAT_YSNO = VALUES(CHAT_YSNO) , RDUE_YSNO = VALUES(RDUE_YSNO) , LKDF_YSNO = VALUES(LKDF_YSNO) , RPDF_YSNO = VALUES(RPDF_YSNO) , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserInterestCatalog */ FN_GET_CODE_NAME(CATEGORY.COMM_CODE, CATEGORY.COMD_CODE, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS INTR_CNAM , DETAIL.COMD_CODE AS INTR_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(DETAIL.COMM_CODE, DETAIL.COMD_CODE, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS INTR_NAME , CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR AS CGRP_ORDR , DETAIL.SORT_ORDR AS CODE_ORDR FROM TB_CODEXD CATEGORY INNER JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON CATEGORY.COMM_CODE = DETAIL.COMM_CODE AND CATEGORY.COMD_CODE = DETAIL.UPPR_CODE AND COALESCE(DETAIL.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE CATEGORY.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND CATEGORY.UPPR_CODE IS NULL AND COALESCE(CATEGORY.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} ORDER BY COALESCE(CATEGORY.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , CATEGORY.COMD_CODE , COALESCE(DETAIL.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , DETAIL.COMD_CODE

SELECT /* getUserInterestList */ FN_GET_CODE_NAME(PARENT.COMM_CODE, PARENT.COMD_CODE, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS INTR_CNAM , INTEREST.INTR_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(DETAIL.COMM_CODE, DETAIL.COMD_CODE, NULL, #{languageCode}) AS INTR_NAME , PARENT.SORT_ORDR AS CGRP_ORDR , DETAIL.SORT_ORDR AS CODE_ORDR FROM TB_USINTR INTEREST JOIN TB_CODEXD DETAIL ON DETAIL.COMM_CODE = #{categoryCode} AND DETAIL.COMD_CODE = INTEREST.INTR_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD PARENT ON PARENT.COMM_CODE = DETAIL.COMM_CODE AND PARENT.COMD_CODE = DETAIL.UPPR_CODE WHERE INTEREST.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY COALESCE(PARENT.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , PARENT.COMD_CODE , COALESCE(DETAIL.SORT_ORDR, 9999) , DETAIL.COMD_CODE
